name: Ikebukuro
tagline: Shinjuku in 7 minutes and Shibuya in 12 minutes. Served by 9 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, served by JR Yamanote Line, JR Saikyo Line, Narita Express, JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line, Tobu Tojo Line, Seibu Ikebukuro Line, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line and Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 18 minutes to Otemachi, 7 minutes to Shinjuku, 12 minutes to Shibuya and 33 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 32.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 32.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 31.6 m to 33.6 m, a difference of 2.0 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 19 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 宏明会池袋大久保病院, about 297 m away and 榎本クリニック, about 312 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 9 lines serve the station: JR Yamanote Line, JR Saikyo Line, Narita Express, JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line, Tobu Tojo Line, Seibu Ikebukuro Line, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line and Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 4 lines, Tobu runs 1 line, Seibu runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 3 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 100.

rentRange.note: One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Toden-Zoshigaya is ahead on quiet, but Ikebukuro is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: 944 m away in a straight line. It takes 8 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Ikebukuro. One-room rents run about ¥8,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Ikebukuro is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: 982 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Ikebukuro. One-room rents run about ¥9,000 higher.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi

People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: 明治通 (a main road) runs 159 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 13 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the 明治通 (a main road) runs 159 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
